text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, this brings back memories~.
The dorms are as pretty as always♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A second summer training camp to build ability.
Having pushed past her peak training phase,
Curren Chan's expression was radiant...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because your love
kept Curren going...♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It was your love, Big Sis,
that kept Curren going... ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, but it's true, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Just a little longer until the climactic battle,
the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Let's get through this summer and get su~per strong♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Beyond a shadow of a doubt,
a scorching summer training camp is about to begin!
